name: NEI Fall Congress 2026
description: The annual psychopharmacology congress of the Neuroscience Education Institute, offered in person at The Broadmoor and online, with up to 32 CME credits. Pre conference programs begin November 4 and the scientific poster session is held November 7, 2026.

deadlines.label: Poster abstract submission deadline
deadlines.note: Presenters must attend in person; virtual poster presentations are not accepted. Accepted abstracts are published in the NEI Virtual Poster Library with a DOI in CNS Spectrums.

sources.note: Confirms November 5 to 8, 2026, Colorado Springs, CO and online.
Confirms venue The Broadmoor and pre conference programs beginning November 4.
Confirms abstract deadline Monday, August 3, 2026 and poster session November 7, 2026.
Registration open; no tier deadlines shown.

notes: The poster deadline has passed. No 2027 Fall Congress dates are published; NEI lists a 2027 Spring Congress on May 21 to 23, 2027 in Florida. Registration fee tiers and deadlines were not visible on the registration page.
